features.title: Core AST Parser with Language Plugins
acceptance: Parse Python, JavaScript, TypeScript files into AST nodes
Extract imports, functions, classes, and their relationships
Output deterministic graph edges (calls, imports, inheritance)
No LLM required - fully offline deterministic parsing

features.title: Graph Storage & Query API
acceptance: SQLite-backed persistent graph storage
REST API for querying nodes/edges with pagination/filtering
Export to GraphML, JSON, DOT formats

features.title: React Web UI for Graph Exploration
acceptance: Dashboard showing codebase overview stats
Interactive graph visualization (cytoscape.js)
Search/filter nodes by type, name, file
Node detail panel with source location

features.title: CLI /graphify Skill Integration
acceptance: CLI command to parse a directory and output graph
Integration with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI
Configurable output formats

features.title: SQL Schema & Config File Parsers
acceptance: Parse SQL DDL for tables, columns, FK relationships
Parse YAML/JSON/TOML configs as structured nodes
Extract relationships from config references

features.title: PDF Documentation Parser
acceptance: Extract text/structure from PDF docs
Link doc sections to code symbols
Output as graph nodes with source references
